name: io.github.Hei33enberg/poxi
description: AI-native 3D venue generator and 0% commission ticketing engine. Generate arenas, stadiums and clubs from a prompt, then hold seats atomically (600s TTL, no double-booking), check out through Stripe Connect, and scan tickets at the gate.

environmentVariables.name: POXI_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Poxi API origin. All tools call ${POXI_API_URL}/v1/...

environmentVariables.name: POXI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional bearer token for authenticated accounts.
